intents.narrative_purpose: This proposal is the most compact and temporally adjacent to the equalizer window (6403.81s–6410.07s vs equalizer buildup at ~6442s). The three interceptions are all non-replay footage events and the observation query targets whether the final interception (event_000636) initiates forward progression toward the equalizer. This directly addresses the unresolved question of whether the buildup-to-equalizer transition has omitted causal state.
